content.title: How to purchase Cody Johnson tickets | Houston Livestock Show and Rodeo
content.text: » Buy Tickets Individual tickets for Cody Johnson’s concert-only performance with Jon Pardi and Randy Houser on March 22, 2026, are on sale. Download the RODEOHOUSTON® Mobile App, powered by AXS, and use the mobile ticket guide to access your tickets. When will tickets go on sale for the concert-only performance by Cody Johnson, scheduled for March 22, 2026? Individual tickets for Johnson’s concert-only performance went on sale to the public Thursday, Aug. 21 at 10 a.m. through rodeohouston.com. The Online Waiting Room opened at 9:30 a.m. and customers in the Online Waiting Room were randomly selected to enter the store to purchase tickets at 10 a.m. A place in the Online Waiting Room did not guarantee ticket availability. How much are tickets for the Cody Johnson concert-only performance? Ticket prices start at $49, plus a $5 per ticket convenience fee. All prices below include fees. View Floor Map Upper Level: $54-$74 Loge Level: $84-$104 Club Level: $164-$194 Field Level: $164-$224 Action Seats: $254-$304 Floor: $254-$354 Chairman’s Club Party Deck, presented by AXS: $244 Browse available suites and premium seating tickets A limit of four (4) tickets per person will be permitted. All tickets will be delivered electronically via AXS Mobile ID; please allow 48 hours for delivery. How many tickets am I allowed to purchase for Cody Johnson’s concert-only performance?For individual ticket sales, a limit of four (4) tickets per person will be permitted. How will I receive my Cody Johnson RODEOHOUSTON tickets? All tickets will be delivered electronically via AXS Mobile ID. Please allow 48 hours for delivery. To access your purchased tickets, download the RODEOHOUSTON mobile app, select “More” and log in to your Rodeo Ticket Account at the top of the menu. View the mobile ticket guide for step-by-step instructions on using the mobile app. Are the ticket prices similar to the RODEOHOUSTON concerts for the rest of the season?Tickets for Johnson’s performance reflect special concert-only ticket pricing. What can buyers do beforehand to prepare? Pre-register for a Rodeo Ticket Account via rodeohouston.com The Rodeo Ticket Account is your account for all Houston Livestock Show and Rodeo™ admission tickets purchased through AXS, the Rodeo’s official ticket provider. This account allows buyers to manage their ticket purchases, ticket transfers and ticket sales on the AXS secondary market, the Rodeo’s only verified secondary market. Access your Rodeo/Concert ticket via the RODEOHOUSTON mobile app and log in using your Rodeo Ticket Account. View the mobile ticket guide for step-by-step instructions on using the mobile app Review the seating chart available on rodeohouston.com What should people know when they buy resale tickets? Rodeo guests can purchase secondary market tickets through AXS, the Rodeo’s only verified secondary market, at rodeohouston.com/tickets. Secondary market tickets will be subject to availability. Once secondary market tickets are available to purchase, they will appear in the link alongside primary market tickets. Purchasing tickets through AXS, the Rodeo’s official ticket provider, allows buyers a safe place to purchase RODEOHOUSTON tickets on the secondary market with the security of knowing tickets purchased are valid for entry. Who is opening for the Cody Johnson concert-only performance?Jon Pardi and Randy Houser will perform as the opening artists for Cody Johnson. Learn more. What time is the Cody Johnson concert-only performance?Performances with special guests Jon Pardi and Randy Houser begin at 6:30 p.m. Cody Johnson takes the stage at approximately 8:40 p.m. NRG Stadium gates open at 5 p.m. Will everything on the NRG Park grounds be open on the day of the Cody Johnson concert? Will there be a rodeo before his concert? There is no rodeo scheduled before the Cody Johnson concert, however, all activities on the grounds, including shopping and dining areas, carnival, livestock and horse show competitions, and other exhibits and attractions at NRG Park, will be open to the public on Sunday, March 22. When will the remaining 2026 RODEOHOUSTON entertainer lineup be announced?The remaining 2026 RODEOHOUSTON entertainer lineup will be announced in early 2026.
